GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 1300m, improved marginally to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide at 400m, ran on hitting Lead at the 170m, kept going to post. [Stewards: Raced keenly early and near 1300m.] # pipped on post
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early and near the 1300m, steadied from heels and shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then worked up to settle down 2nd Two Wide Outside Lead and trailing 1.5 lengths, moved to within 0.75 Lengths turning, hit Lead 120m and kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Approaching the 1000m was awkwardly placed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, lost a length in straight. (Gelded) [Stewards: Small amount of blood noted in its mouth. Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted at gates after a small amount of blood was noted in gelding’s mouth. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Missed the start and Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , little change to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed cuts to the off-hindleg.] # missed the start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam revealed cuts to the off-hind leg.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Headed 1200m, shuffled back to 4 Lengths rail turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Winkers FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Improved onto heels near the 1100m and steadied. Near the 300m, momentarily raced in restricted room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 6.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked Six Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced greenly in straight.] # Wide early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced greenly in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground in straight. First start: Need to see again. # distant 3rd place
